title: ManifestAcceptance V3
$comment: PROPOSED_NOT_ADOPTED. Structure only; no object, message or signature is instantiated. This schema does not register an operational profile, establish authority/applicability, or grant acceptance, Genesis or execution permission. ML-D124 confirms only the isolated development interpretation that authority_ref targets the same independent BootstrapGovernanceRoot as bootstrap_governance_root_ref; the two exact refs must be checked by a semantic consumer. Independent profiles and semantic consumption must check ordered sets, exact five kind/stage/subject/support/coverage, root/rule/role/key/effective bindings, canonical identities, approved public authentication and complete G10. A structurally empty blocker list is not evidence of no blockers. Missing inputs remain unresolved. Existing MA2, policy drafts and guards are unchanged. ML-D134 repository-schema admission preview only; the proposed URI does not establish publication or applicability.

required_validation_report_refs.$comment: Five distinct full pairs only. Ordering and one exact instance per required kind need independent semantic checks, not uniqueItems alone. R4T support and post-signature RfinalB are outside these five.

authority_ref.$comment: ML-D124 confirms the isolated development interpretation: authority_ref must equal bootstrap_governance_root_ref and target the independently supplied BootstrapGovernanceRoot. This generic exact-ref shape cannot check equality, target type, authority, role, scope or effective history; semantic consumption and independent evidence remain required. No operational adoption is implied.

reason_codes.$comment: ASCII sorted-set order and applicable vocabulary require semantic consumption. Empty remains structurally permitted.

blocking_finding_refs.$comment: Full-pair order, exact finding content and independently complete blocker coverage are semantic duties.
